name: Bryce Willingham
strengths: Willingham mirrors receivers in man with sticky feet and stays attached through stems.
Willingham closes throwing windows quickly and contests at the catch point without panicking.
Willingham shows recovery twitch when beaten a step — does not give up on the route.
weaknesses: Willingham still needs to add functional strength to play through bigger SEC outside receivers at the line.
comparison: Willingham comps to Trent McDuffie — 5-11 press/man corner with twitch, sticky feet, and recovery speed in phase.
projection: Willingham projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at CB (nickel / special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC press corner — the twitchy man cover piece who can lock the perimeter.
